facts.text: Per-answer memory records are written by `captureTaskCandidates` only for completed tasks: kind `fact`, id `answerId(session,task,question)`, source `taskmanage-answer:<session>:<task>:<question>`, tags `taskmanage-answer` plus `evidence-anchored` or `evidence-unanchored`. Text is `Q:`/`A:`/`Task:` lines, plus an `Unresolved evidence:` line when any ref fails.

`resolveAnswerRef` resolves `tool:Name#n` to `<session>.jsonl#<entryId>` with a redacted excerpt of up to 1000 chars (empty result is unresolved). `path#Lx-Ly` must be inside the workspace, not sensitive, and at most 200 lines, and stores the redacted span text. `file#Heading` stores the heading line. A bare path is existence-only.

An answer record is `verified` only if it has at least one span, heading, or tool ref and no ref is unresolved (`anchorAnswer`); otherwise it stays `candidate`. Verified means evidence resolved and is unchanged, not that the answer is correct.

`recheckAnswerEvidence` re-reads span and heading refs on read and fails with `span_changed` or `heading_changed` when content differs, with `no_evidence` when the list is empty, and with `tool_quote_missing` for tool refs without a quote. Tool refs are not re-read.
Re-capturing an unchanged answer creates no new revision: if the existing record's text equals or starts with the Q/A/Task base, the answer is skipped and its anchors stay frozen.
